name: Research Agent
description: A read-only research analyst that turns public talk on X, Reddit and the web into cited briefs; pair it with the paid ScrapeCreators API to also crawl YouTube and TikTok.

name: Spam-Call Scrubber
description: Finds your phone number on people-search and data-broker sites, files the opt-outs and re-checks on a schedule to cut spam calls.

name: Junk Mail Scrubber
description: Files US opt-outs for credit offers, marketing lists and coupon mailers from just your name and address, then lists exactly what it filed.

name: GreenBuild
description: A senior QA and test-automation lead that writes test plans, triages flaky tests and reviews Playwright and Selenium code.

name: Sell Anything
description: Snap one photo and it prices the item from real sold comps, writes the listing and posts it to FB Marketplace, OfferUp and eBay, with nothing going live without your OK.

name: Invoice Chaser
description: Ranks your overdue invoices by who to chase first, drafts a friendly, firm or final reminder for each and builds the chase schedule; you approve every send.

name: POUNCE
description: Checks AI companies daily for open contests, grants, free credits and hackathons, verifies each deadline and sends you only what's new.

name: ScriptSprint
description: Turns Otter or pasted meeting transcripts into speakers, a summary, decisions and action items.

name: Personal CFO
description: A read-only personal finance hub that links your accounts through Plaid and keeps net worth, cash flow, debts and alerts up to date on a live dashboard.

name: Junk Mail Stopper
description: Snap a photo of a junk mail piece and it files that sender's free removal request, follows up if needed and logs every request it made.

name: MV Forge
description: Turns a song and a prompt into a finished landscape music video, using Grok Imagine footage or code-drawn visuals, with motion captions, beat-synced cuts and its own quality check. Japanese-language template.

name: Highlight Reel
description: Drop in raw sports or training footage and get looping 9:16 hype reels cut to the beat, with captions kept off faces, licensed music options and nothing posted without your OK.

name: Motion Director
description: Designs, animates, scores and QAs short films, character music videos and spoken promos in code, checking every frame and syncing mouths to the vocal.
